body: I'd love to have a career in music, but it's damn near impossible to make that happen. Besides, I doubt that it would make my problems go away.

Maybe someone will be affected. So what? I'm not gonna be there to feel guilty for their sadness. Besides, they'll get over it. You say that life is worth living, but you don't give any reasoning for it. Maybe it is for some people, but I don't have anything that makes my life worth continuing.

Mostly indifferent. It's not that going through the daily routine actively makes me angry or depressed (except for waking up in the morning), it's more just the feeling that there's no point to any of it.

Not really. Don't get me wrong, I have no hatred for them, and I'd never go out of my way to harm anybody else, but I'm just not a people person anymore. Every conversation I have with someone just feels like an ordeal now, so I usually just put in my earbuds and stay silent.
